pairs: quoniam inops et pauper sum ego.
For I am needy and poor.
for I am holy. My God,
salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperantem in te.
bring salvation to your servant who hopes in you.
quoniam ad te clamavi tota die;
for I have cried out to you all day long.
lætifica animam servi tui, quoniam ad te,
Give joy to the soul of your servant,
for I have lifted up my soul to you, Lord.
et multæ misericordiæ omnibus invocantibus te.
and plentiful in mercy to all who call upon you.
and attend to the voice of my supplication.
In die tribulationis meæ clamavi ad te,
In the day of my tribulation, I cried out to you,
Non est similis tui in diis,
There is no one like you among the gods,
et non est secundum opera tua.
and there is no one like you in your works.
All the nations, which you have made,
will draw near and adore in your presence,
And they will glorify your name.
and I will walk in your truth.
so that it will fear your name.
et glorificabo nomen tuum in æternum:
And I will glorify your name in eternity.
quia misericordia tua magna est super me,
For your mercy toward me is great,
et eruisti animam meam ex inferno inferiori.
and you have rescued my soul from the lower part of Hell.
the iniquitous have risen up against me,
et synagoga potentium quæsierunt animam meam:
and the synagogue of the powerful have sought my soul,
et non proposuerunt te in conspectu suo.
and they have not placed you in their sight.
Lord God, are compassionate and merciful,
patiens, et multæ misericordiæ, et verax.
being patient and full of mercy and truthful.
Grant your authority to your servant,
et salvum fac filium ancillæ tuæ.
and bring salvation to the son of your handmaid.
Make me a sign of what is good,
so that those who hate me,
adjuvisti me, et consolatus es me.
O Lord, have helped me and consoled me.
